hostPort.title: Host and Port
hostPort.description: Complete ClickZetta instance and service host, with an optional port.

virtualCluster.title: Virtual Cluster
virtualCluster.description: ClickZetta virtual cluster used for metadata extraction.

databaseSchema.title: Database Schema
databaseSchema.description: Optional schema restriction. When omitted, OpenMetadata attempts to scan all schemas.

queryHistoryTable.title: Query History Table
queryHistoryTable.description: Optional ClickZetta table or view used for usage and query-lineage extraction. Set this to sys.information_schema.job_history to use ClickZetta's native job history; the connector maps its native columns and scopes it to the configured workspace and schema. Custom tables or views must expose query_text, query_type, user_name, database_name, schema_name, start_time, end_time, duration, aborted, and cost columns.

protocol.title: Protocol
protocol.description: Protocol used to connect to ClickZetta.

schemaFilterPattern.title: Default Schema Filter Pattern
schemaFilterPattern.description: Regex to only include or exclude matching schemas.

tableFilterPattern.title: Default Table Filter Pattern
tableFilterPattern.description: Regex to only include or exclude matching tables.

databaseFilterPattern.title: Default Database Filter Pattern
databaseFilterPattern.description: Regex to only include or exclude matching databases.

supportsProfiler.title: Supports Profiler
supportsProfiler.description: ClickZetta profiling remains disabled until its bounded live gate is approved.

supportsDataDiff.title: Supports Data Diff
supportsDataDiff.description: Supports ClickZetta data diff when connectionArguments or connectionOptions includes allowFullTableScan=true and the configured key is stable and supported by the data-diff engine.

supportsDBTExtraction.description: Attached dbt metadata ingestion remains disabled until the Dagster/dbt workflow is live and validated.
